info.title: MICROSERVICE-batchinsertion-Delete Healthcare Appointments Cancel-v5-spec
info.description: The Cancel Healthcare Appointments API provides a streamlined approach to efficiently cancel scheduled healthcare appointments. It enables healthcare providers to manage appointment slots by removing unwanted or unnecessary bookings, ensuring resource optimization and improved patient care. This API is typically utilized by medical administrative staff and healthcare management systems that require automated appointment adjustments. By targeting specific appointments for cancellation, users can enhance operational effectiveness and maintain accurate scheduling.

delete.description: This endpoint allows users to cancel an appointment that has been previously scheduled. Ensure that the appointment ID is valid and that the cancellation occurs within the allowed timeframe.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to cancel an appointment. The client must specify the necessary details in the JSON format to identify the appointment to be canceled.

200.description: The appointment has been successfully canceled.

DeleteHealthcareAppointmentsCancelReques.description: This schema represents the request body for cancelling an appointment operation.

status.description: Indicates if the cancellation was successful.

referenceNumber.description: The reference number associated with the appointment cancellation.

resultId.description: A unique identifier for the result of the cancellation request.

state.description: Current state of the appointment after the cancellation request.

processingTimeMs.description: Time taken to process the cancellation request in milliseconds.

message.description: A descriptive message regarding the cancellation request.

DeleteHealthcareAppointmentsCancelRespon.description: Response schema for the successful cancellation of an appointment.

createdBy.description: Username or identifier of the user who created the record.

createdAt.description: Timestamp of when the record was created.

automated.description: Indicates if the operation was performed automatically.

AuditInfo.description: Information related to the audit trail of the operation.

schema.description: The time taken to process the request, measured in milliseconds.
